ablation_slope.description: observed vs exact choice-logit shift when the joint posterior is displaced at L0, through its 8-dimensional encoding subspace, to η_(i,j) = (η_A,i + η_B,j)/3 − 1/9, on the episodes whose offer probabilities stay at least 0.02 under the target (SE 0.000)

ablation_slope_in_range.description: the same on the episodes whose implied offer values both stay within the payoff range (SE 0.001)

posterior_steer_slope.description: positive control: the posterior steer of factor A written through the same subspace at L0 as a change of its margin only, observed vs the exact counterfactual under the target factor posterior (SE 0.002)

control_slope.description: the ablation's edit norms in random directions orthogonal to the encoding subspace, on the ablation's counterfactual and episodes (SE 0.000)
